final: WITH product_counts AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), product_shares AS (SELECT line_count, 1.0 * line_count / SUM(line_count) OVER () AS share FROM product_counts), compared AS (SELECT line_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_avg_share FROM product_shares) SELECT SUM(line_count) AS combined_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_avg_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > overall_avg_share
